description: Defines the FeatureFlags struct with various feature toggle fields, default settings, and a method to convert flags to a map.

classes.name: FeatureFlags
classes.description: A struct representing various feature flags for the application, including testing, sharing, UI, and experimental features.

methods.name: SetDefaults
methods.description: Initializes the feature flags with default values.

methods.name: ToMap
methods.description: Returns the feature flags as a map of string keys to string values, supporting boolean and string flags.
